decks.notes: The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption, counterspells, removal, and card advantage. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Counterspell, Fatal Push, and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to maintain control of the game while slowly grinding out a victory. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Drown in the Loch and Sink into Stupor provide further disruption options to keep the opponent off balance. Overall, the deck focuses on controlling the game's pace and gradually wearing down the opponent's resources.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. It aims to quickly build up a board presence and deal damage before the opponent can stabilize. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Blood Moon and Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional value and flexibility. Overall, the deck is designed to be fast, efficient, and relentless in its pursuit of victory.

The main strategy of this deck is to assemble the Amulet Titan combo in order to ramp quickly and efficiently into powerful threats like Primeval Titan. By utilizing cards like Amulet of Vigor and Explore to generate additional mana, the deck can play its key pieces ahead of schedule and overwhelm opponents with its high-impact threats. With a variety of lands and utility cards, the deck is able to search for key pieces, protect its combo, and ensure consistency in executing its game plan.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast and efficient aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck utilizes cards like Guide of Souls and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to pump up creatures and deal extra damage, while utilizing cards like Galvanic Discharge and Lightning Bolt to remove threats from the opponent's board. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of versatility to the deck. Overall, this deck aims to win the game quickly through a combination of creature aggression and direct damage spells.

The deck focuses on using a combination of counterspells, removal, and card advantage to control the game and outvalue the opponent. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while gradually gaining advantages through card draw and efficient removal spells. The inclusion of Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog as win conditions allows the deck to close out games once it has established control. The deck also utilizes various lands to fix mana and ensure consistency in its spells, while also including some versatile cards like Cling to Dust for additional interaction.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using Eldrazi Temple and other mana sources, while controlling the board with cards like Ugin's Labyrinth and All Is Dust. The deck aims to cheat out powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog using cards like Through the Breach, overwhelming the opponent with massive threats. The inclusion of cards like Kozilek's Command and Sowing Mycospawn provides additional control and disruption, making it difficult for the opponent to mount a defense against the Eldrazi onslaught.

This aggro deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with cards like Burning Inquiry, Goblin Lore, and Street Wraith to enable powerful plays with cards like Hollow One and Dragon's Rage Channeler. Detective's Phoenix and Ox of Agonas provide additional threats that can be brought back from the graveyard. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the strategy revolves around aggressive plays and utilizing the graveyard to maximize card advantage and power on the battlefield.

The key concept of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana quickly using rituals and medallions, cast spells that draw cards or provide additional resources like Wish and Reckless Impulse, and then use Ral, Monsoon Mage to deal damage and finish off the opponent. Past in Flames allows for the reuse of key spells, and Glimpse the Impossible can create explosive turns by casting multiple spells for free. The deck aims to create a powerful storm of spells that overwhelm the opponent and win the game in a single turn.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using Eldrazi Temple, Talisman of Impulse, and other mana sources, in order to cast high-cost Eldrazi creatures like Ulamog, Emrakul, and Devourer of Destiny. Control elements like All Is Dust and Kozilek's Command help to keep the opponent's board in check, while cards like Through the Breach allow for explosive plays by putting Eldrazi creatures directly onto the battlefield. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures while maintaining control of the game.

The deck is focused on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a flood of Merfolk creatures, using cards like Master of the Pearl Trident and Tide Shaper to boost their strength. The deck also includes disruption elements like Merfolk Trickster and Harbinger of the Tides to control the board. The use of Aether Vial allows for easy deployment of creatures, while cards like Spreading Seas and Sink into Stupor disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to apply relentless pressure while disrupting the opponent's plans, ultimately securing a swift victory.

This deck focuses on using a combination of Eldrazi creatures and control spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating value with powerful effects. The strategy revolves around ramping up mana quickly with cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Impulse to cast big Eldrazi threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. Kozilek's Command and Kozilek's Return provide versatile removal options, while Malevolent Rumble and Sowing Mycospawn help control the board. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats and disruption while maintaining board control.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize Eldrazi creatures to ramp up mana quickly and control the game. The deck includes cards like Ancient Stirrings and Talisman of Impulse to accelerate mana generation. Through the Breach allows for quick access to powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn. Kozilek's Command and Kozilek's Return provide control over the board while Ugin's Labyrinth slows down opponents. The deck also includes utility lands like Cavern of Souls and Grove of the Burnwillows to further support the Eldrazi strategy.

The deck focuses on using countermagic and removal spells to control the board while using powerful artifacts and enchantments like The One Ring and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to generate advantage and win the game. The deck also includes versatile cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Tune the Narrative to outmaneuver opponents and protect key pieces. The goal is to establish dominance over the game through a combination of control elements and powerful threats that are difficult for opponents to deal with effectively.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's strategy through a combination of counterspells, removal, and card advantage. The deck focuses on efficiently dealing with threats while generating value through cards like Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog. By using a mix of permission spells, removal, and card draw, the deck aims to dictate the pace of the game and outvalue the opponent in the long run. The mana base is designed to support the deck's game plan with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistency and access to all necessary colors.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells, while also utilizing powerful enchantments like Blood Moon and Static Prison to disrupt their game plan. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides an additional mana source and adds consistency to the deck. With a mix of efficient creatures, removal, and disruptive elements, this Boros Aggro deck aims to apply pressure from multiple angles and close out the game before the opponent can establish their own strategy.

This deck aims to quickly ramp up mana using rituals and medallions to cast a large amount of spells in a single turn, leading to a powerful combo finish with cards like Grapeshot or Past in Flames. It utilizes Ral, Monsoon Mage and Wish to tutor for key pieces of the combo, while also using cards like Reckless Impulse and Valakut Awakening for card advantage. The goal is to chain together spells to generate a massive storm count and overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells in a single turn.
